prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection worked, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, along with path duration and persistence hints, frequently worked, though several hints showed no clear effect or hurt.
Personality-driven headlines, headline refreshes, and live generation countdown timers worked, but general story copy, photo quality guidance, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Select layout redesigns and tutorial screens worked (such as the photo upload split layout and desktop tray guide screen), whereas sub-flows, trait selectors, and flow bypasses either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, wait-screen activity tips, badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted headlines, live timers, and specific guide or layout updates.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop pet status verification screen: Adds a post-generation verification step that confirms the companion successfully rendered on the desktop before completing setup. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open after the waiting step.)
1: [finish, redesign] Spotlight stage finish welcome redesign: Rebuilds the final onboarding screen into a spotlight stage layout emphasizing active companion status. (why: Finish step drop-off is 23.7% and multiple users were confused about pet controls immediately after onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet sign-in safety hint: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in preserves existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation system status progress info: Adds active background system status text alongside the live timer during pet generation. (why: The home waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path selection journey headline update: Updates the story headline to highlight fast path selection clarity. (why: Learnings show targeted headline refreshes improve early funnel speed and conversion.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo processing optimization hint: Displays a hint during photo upload reassuring users that uploaded photos are automatically optimized. (why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation output looking unexpected.)
6: [home, notification] Background generation ready desktop alert: Enables a desktop notification option when companion generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Users face high mean wait times (2336s) and lose context while waiting for pet creation.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Tray navigation guide final screen: Adds a new end-of-flow screen showing users how to control and hide the desktop pet via the system tray. (why: 3 support emails indicated confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)

scores.note: Extra verification sub-flows and post-generation steps historically hurt or show no gain.
Finish step has high drop-off, but finish redesigns previously dropped conversion by 3.9%.
Top support complaint backed by strong evidence; targeted sign-in persistence hints reliably work.
Addresses extreme mean wait times on home step; wait info updates consistently perform well (+1.5%).
Story copy changes at path selection historically underperformed (-1.6% across 6 tests).
Targeted at adoption drop-off, but photo quality guidance hints showed no clear positive effect.
High wait times justify intervention, but notification experiments previously showed minimal effect.
Tray guide screens explicitly proven effective in prior lessons; finish new screens average +0.9%.
